rationale: Recent runs plateaued on recurrent-tail architecture tweaks. This keeps the current best tail-QK precision recipe intact and pivots to the highest-priority untested local MLX direction from the notes: SP4096-style small-batch training. Lowering TRAIN_BATCH_TOKENS from 6144 to 4096 should buy materially more optimizer updates inside the same 600s wallclock and also densify the late quant-aware phase, while nudging MUON_MOMENTUM_WARMUP_START to 0.90 aligns the optimizer with the softer small-batch local setting without reintroducing the sharper QK-gain changes that already missed. I also log the warmup start explicitly so the run record captures the transplant.
title: SP4096 Small-Batch Transplant On Recurrent Tail QK Best
